kpis.label: Count by Category
kpis.description: Record count grouped by the primary categorical dimension.
kpis.sql: SELECT "checkpoint_ns" AS category, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM srcdb."public"."checkpoints" GROUP BY "checkpoint_ns" ORDER BY record_count DESC

kpis.label: Total Records
kpis.description: Total number of rows in the primary table.
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM srcdb."public"."checkpoints"
